Huang, Titus, Lakusta and Held (1994) DBH–height models for Alberta tree species

Source: R/hd_huang1994.R
hd_huang1994.Rd

Vectorized implementation of the ecologically based individual-tree height–diameter models in Huang, Titus, Lakusta and Held (1994; Alberta Pub. T/291). Predicts total tree height (m) from DBH (cm), optionally by natural-region group.

Usage

hd_huang1994(DBH, species, natural_subregion = NULL, keep_model_id = FALSE)

Arguments

DBH

Numeric vector. Tree level. Diameter at breast height (1.3 m above ground), outside bark, in cm. Must be >= 0.

species

Character vector. Tree level. NFI species codes (e.g. "PICE.GLA"; compact "PICEGLA" is accepted), or "CONIF" / "DECID" for the source's softwood / hardwood group models.

natural_subregion

Optional. Plot level. Alberta natural region (source Appendix 2), given as the 2006 natural subregion numeric code 1–21 or character code (e.g. "CM" = Central Mixedwood, "LF" = Lower Foothills), as in hd_huang2016(). Length 1 or length(DBH). NULL (default) uses the provincial models.

keep_model_id

Logical. If TRUE, add columns model_id ("huang1994") and subregion_group (the natural-region group of the model used, e.g. "7,8,10", or "provincial").

Value

A tibble with column height (m) and, if keep_model_id = TRUE, model_id and subregion_group.

Details

Model scope (species coverage): aspen (POPU.TRE), balsam poplar (POPU.BAL), white birch (BETU.PAP), lodgepole pine (PINU.CON), jack pine (PINU.BAN), white spruce (PICE.GLA), Engelmann spruce (PICE.ENG), black spruce (PICE.MAR), balsam and subalpine fir (ABIE.BAL, ABIE.LAS; fitted together in the source), Douglas-fir (PSEU.MEN) and tamarack (LARI.LAR). The source's natural-region "Softwood group" and "Hardwood group" models are selected with species = "CONIF" and "DECID"; they exist only by natural-region group and therefore require natural_subregion.

Model form (p. 2): $$H = 1.3 + a [1 - \exp(-b\, DBH)]^{c},$$ fitted by weighted nonlinear least squares (weights \(1/DBH\)).

Height convention: total tree height; DBH outside bark at 1.3 m, so predicted height tends to 1.3 m as DBH tends to 0.

Variants (natural-region groups): if natural_subregion is NULL (default) the provincial models (Table 2) are used. Otherwise the model for the species' natural-region group (Table 1) is used; the source recommends these where the natural region is known (p. 16). The 1994 natural regions 1–20 share their numeric codes with the 2006 natural subregions; 2006 subregion 21 (Upper Boreal Highlands), split from 1994 region 6 (Boreal Highlands), uses the region-6 models. The grassland regions 17–20 and rows with NA natural_subregion have no regional models and use the provincial model, as do species fitted only at the provincial level (BETU.PAP, PINU.BAN, PICE.ENG, PSEU.MEN, LARI.LAR). For "CONIF" and "DECID", which have no provincial model, such rows return NA height with a warning. One-time messages report which variant is used.

Rows with NA DBH or species return NA height. DBH values outside the provincial range of the fitting data for the species (Table 3) are computed and reported in a single warning; no ranges are published for the softwood/hardwood groups.

References

Huang, S., Titus, S.J., Lakusta, T.W., and Held, R.J. (1994). Ecologically based individual tree height-diameter models for major Alberta tree species. Report #2, Pub. No. T/291. Alberta Environmental Protection, Land and Forest Services, Edmonton, Alberta.

See also

hd_huang2016(), hd_model_registry(), get_hd_model_info()

Examples

# Provincial models
hd_huang1994(DBH = c(10, 25, 40), species = c("PICE.GLA", "POPU.TRE", "PINU.CON"))
#> hd_huang1994(): `natural_subregion` not supplied; using the provincial models.
#> This message is displayed once per session.
#> # A tibble: 3 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   10.1
#> 2   21.7
#> 3   25.5

# Natural-region-group models (Lower Foothills), numeric or character code
hd_huang1994(DBH = 25, species = "PICE.MAR", natural_subregion = "LF")
#> hd_huang1994(): using natural-region-group models where available.
#> This message is displayed once per session.
#> # A tibble: 1 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   18.2
hd_huang1994(DBH = 25, species = "PICE.MAR", natural_subregion = 11,
             keep_model_id = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   height model_id  subregion_group
#>    <dbl> <chr>     <chr>          
#> 1   18.2 huang1994 7,8,9,10,11    

# Softwood group model (natural-region groups only)
hd_huang1994(DBH = 30, species = "CONIF", natural_subregion = "CM")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   23.0
